goalDescription: Die lernende Person kann Beziehungen zwischen kulturellem Wandel, Migration und Integration erläutern.
reviewerModel: Codex; exact serving model identifier not exposed
aspectRatioDecision: Close native16:9 landscape; no exception needed. Format not mechanically normalized.

actualInspection.fachlichePruefung: A shared celebration depicts reciprocal conversation, food preparation, music and crafts alongside school, work and civic participation symbols. People contribute and exchange with equal dignity; no national flags, binary us/them groups, one-way assimilation or automatic conflict-resolution claim is shown.
actualInspection.phone: At 360 px the shared exchange, large heading and school/work/civic icons remain recognizable. Decorative textiles, foods and small notices do not require reading.
actualInspection.desktop: At 680 px several reciprocal activities and the civic links are clear without assigning one protected group to a fixed social role.
actualInspection.actorPerspective: The cooking, music and craft participants face their actual tools and each other; public notices face the gathering. No unreadable or inverted work document is necessary.
actualInspection.style: Friendly clear comic raster, coherent broad colors and approachable people, without photorealism or sterile technical restyling.

interpretationLimits: This selected cultural-exchange scene does not exhaust culture, establish migration status by appearance or imply that cultural exchange always resolves conflicts.
goalTextStatus: Actual current canonical German title/description inspected and matched to bilingual E1 author candidate; no D/P gate attested by this image review.
